description: Find U.S. rail-trails, canal towpaths and greenways by name, state, surface, kind and length. Returns each trail's page URL and slug (for get_trail). With no query, lists the longest trails that match the filters.

kind.description: rail: on a former railway; trolley: an old streetcar or interurban line; canal_towpath: beside a canal; greenway: a car-free path not on a railbed.

query.description: Words from the trail's name, for example "Great Allegheny Passage" or "Virginia Creeper". Small typos are tolerated.

state.description: Two-letter state code (PA) or state name. Matches every trail that enters the state.

surface.description: Trail surface. crushed_stone is packed stone dust, good for most bikes.

name: search_trails
title: Search trails
